encoding_notes: SOURCE: live HTML guide (journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/TAB) Cloudflare/bot-blocked — 403 on both WebFetch AND the Apify rag-web-browser headless render. Encoded from SAGE's current official PDF mirror at www.sagepub.com/docs/default-source/msg/submission-guidelines_-therapeutic-advances-in-musculoskeletal-disease_-sage-journals.pdf (sfvrsn token be901b02_5, HTTP 200), text extracted via pypdf. Full clean current content (Impact Factor 4.1) — treat as TIER_A content obtained via the sagepub.com PDF mirror rather than a shell/archive.

Article-type mapping: Original Articles -> original_research; Review Articles (general reviews, perspective reviews, drug reviews) -> review; Systematic Reviews AND Meta-analyses both -> systematic_review (single slot; both use the same 300-word structured abstract [Background; Objectives; Design; Data Sources and Methods; Results; Conclusion; Registration] and 4000-6000-word body); Case Reports -> case_report; Case Series -> case_series; Editorials -> editorial; Letters to the Editor -> letter.

Omitted types (no clean enum slot): Scoping Reviews (the guide instructs authors to submit these UNDER the Original Research article type and flag 'scoping review' in the title; structured abstract Background/Objectives/Eligibility Criteria/Sources of Evidence/Charting Methods/Results/Conclusions; PRISMA-ScR checklist); Study Protocols (structured abstract Background/Objectives/Design/Methods and Analysis/Ethics/Discussion/Registration; up to 6000 words); Brief Reports (concise original research; 150-word structured abstract Background/Objectives/Design/Methods/Results/Conclusion; up to 2000 words; 2 figures/tables in total; max 20 references); Plain Language Summary of Publications (PLS-Ps; standalone peer-reviewed summaries of a prior article; APC $5000).

Blinding: 'Identity transparency: Single-anonymized' and 'adheres to an anonymized peer review process in which the reviewer's name is routinely withheld from the author' -> SINGLE-blind, so double_blind=false and no author-blinding scrub required (scrub_body_identifiers=false, scrub_metadata=false). separate_title_page=false: the guide references 'your manuscript and/or title page' (a title page MAY exist) but does not mandate a separate de-identified title-page document, consistent with single-anonymized review. 'To ensure the integrity of the peer review process we assign reviewers and cannot accept author recommendations.'

Abstract: abstract.structured/sections/max_words encode the PRIMARY type (Original Articles): 'Abstract: Maximum 300 words. Should be structured to include: Background; Objectives; Design; Methods; Results; Conclusion; Registration (if applicable).' max_words=300 is the common cap across most types. NOTE abstract structure/length VARIES by type and cannot all be held in the single abstract block: Review Articles + Case Reports + Case Series = UNSTRUCTURED, max 300; Systematic Reviews/Meta-analyses = structured (Background; Objectives; Design; Data Sources and Methods; Results; Conclusion; Registration); Brief Reports = structured, max 150; Editorials = optional/unstructured; Letters = none. For clinical trials the trial registry name+URL+registration number must appear at the END of the abstract.

Word limits are RECOMMENDED and explicitly flexible ('is recommended (this can be flexible)') and EXCLUDE tables, figure legends and references. Encoded values: original_research 6000; review 'around 4000-6000' -> 6000 upper bound; systematic_review (covers Systematic Reviews + Meta-analyses) 'around 4000-6000' -> 6000; case_report up to 2500; case_series up to 6000; editorial up to 2000 (refs max 20, abstract optional); letter up to 500 excluding references (refs 'should not exceed 10'). Most types state 'Figures/Tables: no limit' and 'References: no limit' -> those caps null. figures_max/tables_max null for all except letter.

SCHEMA GAP (letter figures/tables): the guide says 'There is a limit of one figure OR one table' (a COMBINED cap of one graphic total). The schema's separate figures_max/tables_max fields cannot express the OR; encoded figures_max=1 AND tables_max=1, but the real constraint is one-graphic-total. Editorial APC and Letter APC are 'Free of charge'; all peer-reviewed research/review types carry the standard $3,000 USD APC; PLS-Ps $5000.

sections={}: the guide prescribes ABSTRACT heading structures per type but does NOT give an ordered list of BODY section headings for any article type ('You do not need to follow a template, but please ensure your heading levels are clear'). So no body-sections order is encoded.

References: 'The journal follows the Sage Vancouver reference style' -> style=vancouver. The TAMD guide itself does not quote the in-text marker; the required non-null in_text/order/journal_abbrev fields were set from SAGE's published Sage Vancouver house style page (corroboration): in_text=superscript ('Please use superscript numerals where publications are cited in the text'); in_text_punctuation=after ('If the citation comes at the end of the sentence, the citation number should be placed after the end of sentence punctuation mark'); order=cited ('Publications are referenced in the order in which they appear in the text'); journal_abbrev=nlm ('Journal titles should be abbreviated according to the standard in the Index Medicus'). include_doi=false: not confirmed in reachable text -> conservative false. et_al_threshold=null: Sage Vancouver uses a two-tier rule ('Up to six authors may be listed. If more, list the first three authors and represent the rest by et al.') that the single-integer field cannot represent, and it is not quoted in the journal guide -> left null. max_count=null ('References: no limit' for main types).

Layout ALL null/none: 'The preferred format for your manuscript is Word. You do not need to follow a template' — the guide specifies NO font, size, line spacing, margins, page size, alignment, indent, page numbers, or running head. line_numbers set to 'none' (required non-null enum; guide is silent on line numbering, so the conservative default is no line numbers). page_numbers.show=false and running_head.show=false likewise reflect guide silence.

Figures: separate_files=true (the 'Files' submission list itemizes 'Figures and images' as separate uploads distinct from the manuscript; artwork prepared per Sage's external artwork guidelines). min_dpi=300 ('Figure resolution is 300dpi'). callout_style=null (guide says figures are 'numbered consecutively in the order in which they appear in the text' but does not specify 'Figure' vs 'Fig.'). formats=[]: the guide does NOT enumerate accepted figure file formats in this text (defers to Sage artwork guidelines). legends_location=figure_legends_section: required non-null enum; figures are separate files (so legends cannot be truly inline) and 'figure legends' is named as a distinct manuscript element excluded from the word count, so legends are collected in the manuscript text — dedicated-section is the most defensible mapping, but the guide does not explicitly name a legends section.

Tables: placement=in_text is a required non-null enum default chosen because the guide gives NO table-placement instruction; in_text = do-not-relocate (least-destructive). numbering=null and caption_position=null: the guide does not state table numbering or caption position. Word count excludes tables; most types state 'Figures/Tables: no limit'.

Declarations: the guide prescribes an ordered back-matter block. Order: 'Acknowledgments' (published at end of article), then 'Author Contributions heading ... after the Acknowledgements section', then a 'Statements and Declarations' heading whose sub-headings in listed order are 'Ethical considerations' (->ethics_approval), 'Consent to participate' + 'Consent for publication' (both ->patient_consent), 'Declaration of conflicting interest' (->conflict_of_interest), 'Funding statement' (->funding), 'Data availability' (->data_availability). required=all of the Statements-and-Declarations sub-headings plus Author Contributions ('If a declaration is not applicable to your submission, you must still include the heading and state Not applicable'; 'All articles need to include a funding statement ... even if you did not receive funding'; 'The journal requires a declaration of conflicting interests from all authors'; 'Please include the Author Contributions heading'). Acknowledgments left out of required (conditional: 'If you are including an Acknowledgements section'). trial_registration is NOT a declarations sub-heading here — the trial registry name/URL/number goes at the END OF THE ABSTRACT instead.

Misc: orcid_required=true ('Other information required for submission: ORCID ID of the submitting author'; co-author ORCIDs strongly encouraged before acceptance). cover_letter_required=true ('Files: Cover letter. To help the Editor in their preliminary evaluation, please indicate why you think the manuscript suitable for publication' — listed as a submission file with a directive; mildly ambiguous whether strictly mandatory). highlights_required=null (no 'highlights'; the journal offers OPTIONAL plain language summaries ~50-word title + ~300-word summary, video abstracts, infographics). title_case=null (title must be 'concise, descriptive, unambiguous, accurate' but no title/sentence-case rule stated).

Keywords: 'Please include a minimum of 2 keywords, listed after the abstract' -> required=true, min=2; max/case/separator unstated -> null. issn=null: the ISSN is not stated in the guide text (not encoded from memory). Standard license CC BY-NC; APC $3,000 USD (research/review types), Editorials & Letters free, PLS-Ps $5000. Reporting checklists (CARE for case reports/series; PRISMA for systematic reviews; PRISMA-ScR for scoping; PRISMA/MOOSE for meta-analyses) uploaded as supplementary material per EQUATOR.
